Most people who support legal abortion don’t see it as murder. That’s why the debate exists.

The considerations are: 1. Embryos and fetuses are biologically human, but many people believe moral status develops gradually as the brain and awareness develop. Early in pregnancy, the brain connections needed for consciousness and the experience of pain are not yet established. And….

2. Bodily autonomy means that each person has the right to decide what happens inside their own body. Pregnancy is unique because a developing fetus depends completely on one specific person’s body -their blood supply, oxygen, and organs -to survive.

So- The ethical question many people discuss is whether the law should require one person to use their body to sustain another developing life, especially early in pregnancy before consciousness or pain are possible.
